alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:1261fe76-f.title: Account Executive - AI Native
alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:1261fe76-f.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE We are looking for an Account Executive to join our dynamic team. This role is a great fit for those with sales experience looking to grow within a high-growth startup environment. As an Account Executive, you will prospect and close new business alongside our founders and Marketing team. You’ll consult with our existing customer base and prospective customers to build meaningful relationships and shape our product and go-to-market roadmaps. RESPONSIBILITIES - Help build the foundation and processes for customer-facing teams at Baseten - Lead, negotiate, and execute new sales opportunities for Baseten - In partnership with the marketing and BDR team, develop a strong sales pipeline to support quarterly and annual sales targets - Establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders within sales accounts - Work cross-functionally to improve the customer experience and ensure sales effectiveness REQUIREMENTS - 1-3 years of sales experience in a SaaS business - Experience in selling to technical audiences - Experience with developer/machine-learning tooling preferred, but not required - Proven ability to close complex sales cycles - Proficiency with sales and marketing automation tools - Interest in working at an early-stage, fast-paced startup BENEFITS - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity. - 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!) - Paid parental leave - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot - Company-facilitated 401(k) - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities. Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you. At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:12.title: Diesel Mechanic
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:12.description: Our client is looking for a Diesel Mechanic, the primary purpose of this position is to provide basic mechanical, repair, maintenance, and other related services to the customers. This person must have a clear understanding of routine and complex truck and trailer repair processes, routine maintenance tasks, shop techniques and practices, parts, materials and the operation, use, and basic repair of basic shop equipment. Performs assigned duties and tasks to meet Company standards and customer satisfaction. This position reports to the Shop Supervisor but may receive work instructions for specific assignments from a lead mechanic or technician. This position impacts the profitability of the Company by working efficiently, not wasting time on the job, not wasting parts and materials, not breaking tools needlessly, and not creating rework.
responsibilities: Assists Mechanics with completing complex mechanical truck and trailer service, maintenance, and repairs, on all makes and models of trucks and trailers, including, but not limited to working with the following mechanical systems: engine, electrical, drive train, tire, steering, suspension, refrigeration units, etc.
Performs vehicle and trailer inspections according to DOT standards and understands what is necessary to bring identified basic deficiencies into compliance.

Performs routine and complex vehicle fluid and filter checks and replacements.  Checks these systems according to manufacturer’s specifications and replaces fluids and filters with appropriate materials and according to company standards.

Conducts routine vehicle and trailer electrical inspections.  Makes routine replacements of fuses, bulbs, batteries, etc.  Makes routine and complex electrical repairs, installations and replacements.
Performs routine and complex troubleshooting, repair and replacement procedures, on all makes and models of trucks and trailers for engine and related systems.
Performs routine and complex troubleshooting, repair and replacement procedures, on all makes and models of trucks and trailers for electrical and related systems.
Performs routine and complex troubleshooting, repair and replacement procedures, on all makes and models of trucks and trailers for wheel, tire, axle and related systems.
Informs Supervisor regarding problems or difficulties encountered during troubleshooting repair or maintenance procedures.  Discusses any problems, complaints, requests, or ideas with the Supervisor.
Assists the Shop Supervisor with training other mechanics working in the shop.

Assists with managing the stock and equipment inventories as assigned to the shop.  Takes and reports physical counts of stock inventory according to schedule established by the Shop Supervisor.  Notifies Shop Supervisor when stock inventories are approaching reorder points.
Notifies Shop Supervisor in a timely manner when non-stock parts are needed on a maintenance job so that the parts can be ordered quickly and not significantly delay the job’s scheduled completion.
Assists with the training of other technical staff as assigned by answering questions and showing by example.
May be required to cover the shop operations in the event of a vacation or absence of the Shop Supervisor.
Completes all necessary paperwork and reports accurately and submits in a timely manner.
Responsible for keeping assigned company tools available and undamaged at all times, which will include Company assigned tablet.

Will be required to utilize shop software on a daily basis which includes: creating jobs, clocking in and out of jobs, accurately entering all parts used on jobs, and entering all notes efficiently and thoroughly.
qualifications: Requires valid current Iowa driver’s license.
Employee must have the ability to drive all types of trucks, including manual transmissions.
Three to five years of experience with diesel truck repair is preferred, but 2 years of experience is required.
Employee must have the ability to consistently present him/herself and the company to the public in a clean, courteous, and professional manner.
Employee must work professionally and be respectful of all other employees of this company.
Employee must be able to lift up to 100 lbs.
Employee must have the ability to write a work order.
All employment is contingent on passing a pre-employment drug test.
Employee understands all employees must submit to random drug/alcohol testing if they are randomly selected throughout the year, at no cost to the employee.
Requires mechanical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to read technical diagrams and manuals.

foundersfactory-founders-factory:ashbyhq.title: Founder & CEO | Robotics (HealthCare)
foundersfactory-founders-factory:ashbyhq.description: FOUNDER & CEO — NIGHTWATCH One robot. One floor. One job. The automation layer for US senior living Location: United States Start date: ASAP More about the concept here. https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1dxl88PpSjoSBjW0ULKMfhiK7V0AHoY24g6z1BOlYrnE/edit?slide=id.g3f526014c3a_0_0#slide=id.g3f526014c3a_0_0 Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Created by IPO-exited founders, we offer founders capital, operational support from a team of hands-on experts, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry-leading corporate partners. Since 2015, Founders Factory's 450+ portfolio companies have secured 500+ pilots and commercial contracts with our partners. Our Studio partners with entrepreneurs at day one, developing new ideas, technologies and business models into high-growth companies. In partnership with a leading global industrial technology partner, we are building a new portfolio of ventures. ABOUT THE VENTURE America's ~1,900 continuing-care retirement communities (CCRCs) are the only elder-care buyers whose model rewards keeping residents healthier for longer: residents join at 75–80, pay a large entry fee (avg. ~$402k) plus $12–30k a month, and the community carries the lifetime cost of care. These campuses staff their night shifts at roughly twice the regulatory minimum — comfort-driven cover that can't simply be cut — and once holidays, sickness and cover are loaded, each night position carries ~$160k of true annual cost. Worse, the status quo causes the harm it exists to prevent: around 80% of falls happen in the window right after a nurse's check wakes the resident. Existing tech — pull cords, wearables, fixed sensors — is safety kit that never changes the staffing model. We are building NightWatch: a mobile UWB-radar robot that patrols the corridor at night, senses through doors and walls, and reports movement as fact — in bed, out of bed, in the bathroom, on the floor — never as clinical judgement. Data is monitored remotely, and staff are alerted only when a physical check is warranted. No cameras. No wearables. No per-room installation. Sold as robot-as-a-service, it delivers a two-to-three-month payback and is the easiest pilot in the category to say yes to: zero capex, zero installation, nothing entering residents' rooms, and fully reversible. The unfair advantage: our partner brings a production robotics stack already live in market with a paying customer — autonomous navigation, docking and fleet software — plus radar and UWB signal-processing IP already built, manufacturing scale to drive unit cost down, and edge compute that lifts the all-important robots-to-operator ratio. The sensing IP and the ROI model are the moat. OUR OFFER We don't just fund ideas — we co-build them. Join as Founder & CEO and get access to a full-stack venture studio offering designed to give you the best possible start: - The programme runs in two phases: Months 0–6 (Build) - $128k ring-fenced build budget to cover founder stipends and additional specialist resource at the founders' discretion - Founder stipends are $6,675 per founder per month, drawn from this budget - Embedded studio team throughout: a full time venture builder, with support from a broader team consisting of a studio lead and growth marketer. Founders build; the Studio supports. - On-demand access to specialist support across data science, applied AI, fundraising, legal, finance, PR and commercial partnerships - Dedicated network access from day one Months 6–12 (Accelerator / Spinout) - At incorporation, the founding team will receive 70% equity in a new company set up for the venture, and the Studio 15%, both subscribed at nominal value. The remaining 15% is reserved as an employee option pool. - $320k cash investment goes directly into the new venture's bank account at IC approval - full founder discretion over how funds are deployed - Accelerator support: a dedicated squad covering

jobgether-jobgether:lever:12ab20f7-ba4b-.title: Portuguese Voice Actor - Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobgether-jobgether:lever:12ab20f7-ba4b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Portuguese Voice Actor - Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Denmark. This opportunity is designed for an experienced Portuguese voice professional interested in helping shape the next generation of AI-powered speech technologies. You will contribute your voice expertise to training data that helps AI systems communicate with greater clarity, accuracy, and naturalness. The role combines professional voice performance with speech evaluation, linguistic annotation, and AI model feedback. You will record scripted Portuguese content and assess AI-generated speech for pronunciation, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and regional authenticity. Your insights will help improve voice models used across areas such as education, entertainment, accessibility, and digital communication. You’ll work with advanced AI tools while applying your professional judgment and attention to linguistic detail. This is a flexible freelance opportunity for a skilled Portuguese voice actor looking to make a meaningful contribution to AI development. Record high-quality scripted speech samples in Portuguese for use in AI training and voice model development. Evaluate AI-generated speech for linguistic accuracy, pronunciation, naturalness, tone, pacing, emotional expression, and regional variation. Identify, annotate, and clearly document errors or inconsistencies in AI-generated voice outputs. Provide expert feedback that helps improve Portuguese speech models and their ability to produce natural, expressive communication. Collaborate with project teams to refine prompts, evaluation methodologies, voice design guidelines, and quality standards. Apply professional voice acting expertise to ensure recordings demonstrate appropriate clarity, authenticity, delivery, and emotional nuance. Consistently maintain high-quality audio recordings using professional equipment and a suitable recording environment. Follow project instructions, quality standards, annotation guidelines, and data-handling requirements accurately and consistently. Requirements Demonstrated professional experience in Portuguese voice acting, dubbing, narration, broadcasting, or a closely related performance discipline. Strong command of spoken Portuguese, including accurate pronunciation, natural intonation, pacing, and expressive delivery. Ability to recognize and evaluate subtle differences in speech quality, linguistic accuracy, tone, and regional variation. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to provide precise, constructive feedback on AI-generated speech. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain linguistic or performance-related observations effectively. Comfortable working with AI-powered tools and adapting to evolving workflows, evaluation criteria, and project requirements. Experience in voice training, coaching, linguistic annotation, speech evaluation, or AI data projects is a plus. Ability to work independently and consistently meet project requirements and quality standards. Access to a reliable computer, stable internet connection, high-quality microphone, and a quiet environment suitable for professional voice recording. Benefits Freelance contract opportunity with flexible remote work. Pay range of $6–$65 USD per hour , depending on experience, expertise, and geographic location. Opportunity to contribute directly to the development of next-generation AI voice and speech technologies. Work involving advanced AI tools and emerging speech technology workflows. Opportunity to apply professional Portuguese voice expertise to technology with global applications. No company-sponsored health insurance or paid time off, as this is a contractor position. jobgether-jobgether:lever:535a5297-9eae-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Software Engineer based in United States. This is a high-impact technical leadership opportunity for an experienced software engineer working across multiple agile teams and complex product initiatives. You will shape technical direction, influence architecture, and help transform prioritized product roadmaps into scalable, reliable software solutions. The role combines hands-on engineering with system design, code reviews, technical strategy, and cross-team collaboration. You will work on distributed applications and modern cloud-native technologies, with a strong focus on security, performance, scalability, and maintainability. A key part of the position is mentoring engineers and fostering engineering excellence across multiple teams. You will partner closely with product managers and other stakeholders to prioritize work, remove delivery impediments, and achieve business outcomes. This role is ideal for a senior technical leader who enjoys solving complex problems while remaining deeply engaged in software development. Provide technical leadership and direction across multiple agile teams or projects responsible for delivering prioritized software product roadmaps. Design, develop, test, and maintain complex software systems, producing high-quality, maintainable code with strong test coverage. Translate product requirements into robust technical designs for distributed applications that are modular, configurable, reusable, secure, compliant, scalable, and performant. Lead architecture, design, and code reviews across multiple applications, ensuring adherence to engineering standards and best practices. Lead multiple sprint teams within a product area, helping remove technical and delivery impediments and ensuring high-quality solutions are delivered from the product backlog. Collaborate with engineering teams, product managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to estimate effort, prioritize initiatives, plan delivery, and execute roadmap objectives. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers across multiple teams, encouraging innovation, continuous learning, and engineering excellence. Drive technical strategy and vision across multiple teams while championing operational excellence, quality, observability, performance, and maintainability. Apply DevSecOps practices and modern engineering approaches to improve development efficiency, reliability, and software quality. Use analytics, experimentation, and engineering metrics to identify opportunities to improve system speed, scalability, and effectiveness. Promote best practices throughout the software development lifecycle, from architecture and implementation through testing, deployment, and release. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience; a Master’s degree in Computer Science is preferred. 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience with modern technologies and complex software environments. At least 3 years of hands-on experience leading multi-team engineering initiatives within distributed application environments. Strong backend development experience, preferably using Java or Python. Experience with cloud technologies, preferably AWS. Experience overseeing the full software development lifecycle, including architecture, coding, testing, deployment, and release. Proven experience mentoring engineers and providing technical leadership across multiple teams. Experience with generative AI is a plus. Proficiency in one or more industry-standard programming languages such as Java, Python, Go, C++, or JavaScript. Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, design patterns, relational databases, NoSQL databases, and caching technologies. Experience designing and working with APIs

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:0f1db0f1-7a5.title: Croatian Linguistic Lead Tester in Austin, TX
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:0f1db0f1-7a5.description: About Welocalize Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com ROLE OVERVIEW We are looking for a Croatian Linguistic Lead Tester to join a long-term project in Austin, Texas. As a Linguistic Lead Tester, you’ll help bring high-quality Croatian content to life and ensure it feels natural, accurate, and polished for end users. The Onsite Lead Tester is responsible for the overall quality of their language at an account level, as well as the main point of contact for Language Leads. This role is ideal for someone with native-level fluency in Croatian, fluency in English, and strong communication skills. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable working with customers and stakeholders at different levels, can provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback, and confidently present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, customers, and linguists. The ideal candidate also enjoys supporting and training others, sharing knowledge, and helping the team grow, and is available to work full-time. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Managing linguistic tasks Coordination of the linguistic team Reviewing copies and giving feedback to testers Sharing feedback received from the client Supporting testers in understanding corrections resulting from the arbitration process Acting as liaison for terminology, style issues, product features and questions Supporting the onboarding process of new testers Identifying linguistic-specific training needs for the language Creating, maintaining, and delivering linguistic training programs Quality management planning and execution Client engagement Linguistic assets management Completing assigned tasks in a quality and timely manner. REQUIREMENTS Onsite in our offices in Austin, TX. W-2 (eligible for benefits based on hours worked). Monday-Friday (9:00 am - 5:00 pm, with a 1-hour lunch break, 35 hours per week). To be eligible for this role, you’ll need a valid visa permitting you to work in the USA. IDEAL BACKGROUND: Marketing, Journalism, Copy Editing, Proofreading, Writing, Translation, and/or Localization Benefits: ▪️ Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity Insurance ▪️ Telemedicine Benefit ▪️ Paid Sick Time ▪️ Paid Holiday ▪️ Employee Assistance Program Following the eligibility requirements ▪️ Medical Insurance ▪️ Dental Insurance ▪️ Vision Insurance ▪️ HSA ▪️ Voluntary Life Insurance ▪️ 401(k) Retirement Plan Hourly rate: $30 Job Reference: #LI-JC1
